key_insight: ResoLUT converts trained ResNets into deep lookup-table networks while preserving multi-bit residual streams, achieving strong image-classification accuracy and efficient FPGA inference.
engineering_relevance: Layer-wise distillation offers a route from conventional ResNets to hardware-oriented LUT networks without learning logic connectivity from scratch.
method: Distill a trained ResNet layer by layer into LUT trees.
Extract connectivity from the teacher while retaining multi-bit residual streams and BatchNorm.
Use hard LUT decisions during both training and inference to avoid a logic discretization gap.
evidence_signal: ResoLUT achieves 95.66% on CIFAR-10, 78.87% on CIFAR-100, and 53.69% on 64px ImageNet; a separately optimized FPGA model delivers 90.04% CIFAR-10 accuracy at 189k images/s.
watch_item: Peak accuracy and FPGA throughput come from different model configurations, so deployment requires evaluating the accuracy–resource trade-off.
paper_title: ResoLUT: Distilling Residual Networks into Lookup-Table Networks
